title: INTRODUCTION TO FIELD GEOLOGY
description: Build skills to identify igneous, sedimentary, and metamorphic rocks. Recognize and locate rock unit contacts. Establish a field traverse objective based on observations and collect structural and depositional data.  Analyze collected field data through the development of geological maps, interpretive cross-sections, and stratigraphic columns. Interpret geological history in these products and written reports.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisite: GEO 201.
A minimum grade of C- is required in GEO 201.

Students with a term class standing of Freshman may not enroll.
